_comment: Copy this file, then edit K.min, K.max, K.step, p, Delta.values, and n_trials. Keep output_dir, master_seed, solver, dt, t_end, observation_windows, N, and randomness_mode aligned with stage1_pilot.json. Identical run_ids already stored in stage1_runs are skipped. n_trials counts from trial_id 0, so 3 keeps the pilot trial and adds trial_id 1 and 2. This file does not choose which region to refine.
